mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS "id", s.material_code AS "code", s.material_name AS "name", s.new_stock_qty AS "newStockQty", s.edited_qty AS "editedQty", s.effective_date AS "effectiveDate", COALESCE(m.stock_qty, 0) AS "currentStockQty", (SELECT wh.warehouse_nm FROM tb_warehouse wh WHERE wh.warehouse_cd = COALESCE(s.warehouse_cd, m.warehouse_cd) LIMIT 1) AS "warehouse", m.unit_price AS "unitPrice" FROM material_stock_schedule s LEFT JOIN materials m ON m.code = s.material_code WHERE s.applied = 0 ORDER BY s.material_name

SELECT id AS "id", material_code AS "code", new_stock_qty AS "newStockQty", edited_qty AS "editedQty", (SELECT wh.warehouse_nm FROM tb_warehouse wh WHERE wh.warehouse_cd = warehouse_cd LIMIT 1) AS "warehouse" FROM material_stock_schedule WHERE applied = 0 ORDER BY id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM materials WHERE code = #{code}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO material_stock_schedule (material_code, material_name, new_stock_qty, effective_date, applied, created_at, warehouse_cd) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{newStockQty,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, NULL, 0, #{createdAt}, (SELECT wh.warehouse_cd FROM tb_warehouse wh WHERE wh.warehouse_nm = #{warehouse} AND wh.factory_code = 'F001' AND wh.plant_code = 'P001' ORDER BY CASE WHEN wh.use_yn = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, wh.warehouse_id LIMIT 1))
mapper.update: UPDATE material_stock_schedule SET edited_qty = #{qty,jdbcType=DOUBLE} WHERE id = #{id} AND applied = 0
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM material_stock_schedule WHERE id = #{id} AND applied = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(stock_qty, 0) FROM materials WHERE code = #{code}
mapper.update: UPDATE materials SET stock_qty = #{qty,jdbcType=DOUBLE} WHERE code = #{code}

UPDATE materials SET warehouse_cd = (SELECT wh.warehouse_cd FROM tb_warehouse wh WHERE wh.warehouse_nm = #{warehouse} AND wh.factory_code = 'F001' AND wh.plant_code = 'P001' ORDER BY CASE WHEN wh.use_yn = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, wh.warehouse_id LIMIT 1) WHERE code = #{code}
mapper.select: SELECT code AS "code", name AS "name", spec AS "spec", unit_price AS "unitPrice", stock_qty AS "stockQty", unit_weight AS "unitWeight", box_qty AS "boxQty", unit AS "unit", (SELECT i.item_nm FROM tb_common_code_item i JOIN tb_common_code_group g ON g.common_code_group_id = i.group_id AND g.group_code = 'UNIT' JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND t.tenant_code = 'SONGYEON' WHERE i.item_code = unit LIMIT 1) AS "unitNm" FROM materials ORDER BY name

SELECT code AS "code", name AS "name", spec AS "spec", unit_price AS "unitPrice", COALESCE(stock_qty, 0) AS "stockQty", unit_weight AS "unitWeight", box_qty AS "boxQty", unit AS "unit", (SELECT i.item_nm FROM tb_common_code_item i JOIN tb_common_code_group g ON g.common_code_group_id = i.group_id AND g.group_code = 'UNIT' JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND t.tenant_code = 'SONGYEON' WHERE i.item_code = unit LIMIT 1) AS "unitNm" FROM materials WHERE code = #{code}
mapper.update: UPDATE materials SET stock_qty = COALESCE(stock_qty, 0) + #{inQty,jdbcType=DOUBLE} - #{outQty,jdbcType=DOUBLE} WHERE code = #{code}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO material_stock_movement (material_code, material_name, in_qty, out_qty, note, created_at) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{inQty,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{outQty,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{note}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT warehouse_nm FROM tb_warehouse WHERE factory_code = 'F001' AND plant_code = 'P001' AND use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY sort_seq, warehouse_nm, warehouse_id

SELECT s.id AS "id", s.product_code AS "code", s.product_name AS "name", s.new_stock_qty AS "newStockQty", s.edited_qty AS "editedQty", s.effective_date AS "effectiveDate", COALESCE(p.stock_qty, 0) AS "currentStockQty" FROM product_stock_schedule s LEFT JOIN products p ON p.code = s.product_code WHERE s.applied = 0 ORDER BY s.product_name
SELECT id AS "id", product_code AS "code", new_stock_qty AS "newStockQty", edited_qty AS "editedQty" FROM product_stock_schedule WHERE applied = 0 ORDER BY id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE code = #{code}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_stock_schedule (product_code, product_name, new_stock_qty, effective_date, applied, created_at) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{newStockQty,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, NULL, 0, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE product_stock_schedule SET edited_qty = #{qty,jdbcType=DOUBLE} WHERE id = #{id} AND applied = 0
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM product_stock_schedule WHERE id = #{id} AND applied = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(stock_qty, 0) FROM products WHERE code = #{code}
SELECT product_code AS "code", COALESCE(SUM(qty), 0) AS "diff" FROM product_stock_movement WHERE moved_on > #{date} GROUP BY product_code

SELECT product_code AS "productCode", product_name AS "productName", moved_on AS "movedOn", kind AS "kind", qty AS "qty", balance_after AS "balanceAfter", source_table AS "sourceTable", source_id AS "sourceId", (SELECT cln.name FROM clients cln WHERE cln.client_code = product_stock_movement.client_code LIMIT 1) AS "clientName", note AS "note", created_by AS "createdBy", COALESCE((SELECT emp.name FROM employees emp WHERE emp.id = product_stock_movement.created_by LIMIT 1), created_by) AS "createdByName" FROM product_stock_movement WHERE 1 = 1 AND moved_on >= #{start} AND moved_on <= #{end} AND product_code = #{productCode} AND kind = #{kind} ORDER BY moved_on DESC, id DESC LIMIT 2000
SELECT barcode AS "barcode", material_code AS "materialCode", material_name AS "materialName", receive_date AS "receiveDate" FROM material_receiving WHERE barcode = #{barcode} LIMIT 1
SELECT warehouse_nm FROM tb_warehouse WHERE factory_code = 'F001' AND plant_code = 'P001' AND use_yn = 'Y' AND default_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY sort_seq, warehouse_id LIMIT 1
SELECT warehouse_nm FROM tb_warehouse WHERE factory_code = 'F001' AND plant_code = 'P001' AND use_yn = 'Y' AND default_yn = 'N' ORDER BY sort_seq, warehouse_nm, warehouse_id

SELECT id AS "id", material_code AS "materialCode", material_name AS "materialName", barcode AS "barcode", (SELECT wh.warehouse_nm FROM tb_warehouse wh WHERE wh.warehouse_cd = from_warehouse_cd LIMIT 1) AS "fromWarehouse", (SELECT wh.warehouse_nm FROM tb_warehouse wh WHERE wh.warehouse_cd = to_warehouse_cd LIMIT 1) AS "toWarehouse", pack_count AS "packCount", unit_weight AS "unitWeight", qty AS "qty", moved_date AS "movedDate", COALESCE((SELECT emp.name FROM employees emp WHERE emp.id = moved_by LIMIT 1), moved_by) AS "movedBy", created_at AS "createdAt" FROM material_warehouse_move WHERE moved_date = #{date} ORDER BY id DESC
